decisions.reason: Adding logos and colour codes to the asset package does not change the template-format requirement; its same-message Canva and PDF implications are already represented.
The expanded asset package supports future editing but does not change which customer-specific fields must be editable.
The addition of logos and colour codes to delivered assets does not alter the internal-page header's style, content, or identifiers.
The asset-package change does not alter any report identifier or identifier-consistency rule.
The required asset types do not change footer presentation, coverage, interference rules, or version-specific identifiers.
Providing additional reusable assets does not change the dashboard's required fields, score presentation, or communication goal.
The asset-package expansion does not change the required content or scannable presentation of the front-page explanation.
Logos and colour codes are handoff assets; their inclusion does not establish a new visual style or modify the accepted refinement approach.
The asset-package change has no effect on the mapping between report variants and exposure bands.
The expanded set of delivered design assets does not change the warning's presence, visual treatment, clarity, or footer-interference constraint.
The asset-package change does not alter any risk-profile-specific report wording.
